records.question: Compare Tikrikilla and Selsella blocks on Focus Plus: number of distinct beneficiaries, total amount disbursed, and amount disbursed per beneficiary.
records.sql: SELECT lgd_block, lgd_district, COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary_key) AS distinct_beneficiaries, SUM(amount_disbursed) AS total_amount_disbursed, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary_key) > 0 THEN SUM(amount_disbursed) / COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary_key) ELSE 0 END AS amount_per_beneficiary FROM curated.v_focus_plus WHERE lgd_block IN ('TIKRIKILLA', 'SELSELLA') AND NOT lgd_district IS NULL GROUP BY lgd_block, lgd_district ORDER BY lgd_block LIMIT 10
records.answer:
